params.compose:
name: nextcloud
services:
  app:
    image: nextcloud:29.0.4
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data/app:/var/www/html
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    labels:
      opencloud.service: svc_ID
      opencloud.unit: app
  db:
    image: postgres:16.5
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    labels:
      opencloud.service: svc_ID
      opencloud.unit: db
